headline_marked: Miracle rescue: [[One person rescued alive]] after 8 days under rubble
headline: Miracle rescue: One person rescued alive after 8 days under rubble
summary: A survivor was pulled from the debris of a collapsed building, defying odds after being trapped for over a week.
details: A person has been rescued alive from under the rubble of a collapsed building after being trapped for eight days.
The rescue operation was a race against time as teams worked tirelessly to clear the debris and reach the survivor.
The individual was immediately provided with medical assistance upon being pulled from the wreckage.
Such long-term survivals are rare and often depend on factors like air pockets and minimal water intake.
The survivor is currently receiving treatment to stabilize their condition following the prolonged entrapment.
caption:
